findings.title: Alembic revision id duplicates existing migration
findings.problem: The new migration declares revision 'a2b3c4d5e6f7', already used by a2b3c4d5e6f7_add_conversation_id_to_workflow_executions.py (which 3197b8d53564 merges). Duplicate revision ids make the Alembic graph ambiguous/broken (upgrade heads fails or one migration is shadowed), and this one also revises u2v3w4x5y6a7. The migration is additionally outside spec scope (spec lists no Alembic migration for a2a_tasks as out of scope).
findings.impact: Database migration may fail or skip, leaving a2a_tasks without assistant_id/user_id/contextId, so ownership checks and task saves error at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Generate a unique revision id and set down_revision to the actual current head (verify with alembic heads); record the scope exception for the migration in the spec/decisions.
